svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Encore is a watch face that knows what you love: when you start a new series, your
watch gifts you a face designed around that show's world, and you can pick a favourite character or describe a face in
one sentence to have it made for you. The time is always the hero, large and high-contrast for a one-second glance,
while a single glass complication carries heart rate, steps or your episode progress. All text is at least 21 px and
every icon at least 25 px, and the always-on state drops to true black with type only.

g.text: Say it, or type on your phone

svg.text: 368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
